steps.name: 均温数据不足不可判定
steps.drl:
package workbench

// 与业务系统交换的事实类型；输入字段由调用方设置，动作写回输出字段。
declare RuleInput
    granaryId : String
    grainType : String
    storageState : String
    policyVersion : String
    batchId : String
    measuredAt : String
    expectedPoints : Integer
    actualPoints : Integer
    averageTemp : Double
    maxTemp : Double
    minTemp : Double
    coverageRate : Double
    unavailableRate : Double
    layerStats : String
    deltaTemp : Double
    historyComparable : Boolean
    baselineTime : String
    ruleCategory : String
    scopeType : String
    warnThreshold : Double
    criticalThreshold : Double
    recoverThreshold : Double
    minCoverage : Double
    policyEnabled : Boolean
    effectiveFrom : String
    effectiveTo : String
    hasActiveAlarm : Boolean
    activeLevel : String
    confirmState : String
    consecutiveBreaches : Integer
    assessmentCategory : String
    scopeKey : String
    assessmentState : String
    matchedBands : String
    maxCandidateLevel : String
    observedValue : Double
    threshold : Double
    reasons : String
    resultCode : String
    executionState : String
end

rule "均温数据不足不可判定 [1]"
    salience 1
    no-loop true
when
    $input : RuleInput( coverageRate < 0.8d )
then
    modify($input) {
        setAssessmentState("NOT_EVALUABLE"),
        setAssessmentCategory("均温"),
        setMaxCandidateLevel("无"),
        setObservedValue(0.8d),
        setThreshold(0.8d),
        setScopeKey("均温-整仓"),
        setReasons("有效测点覆盖率不足")
    }
end
